issues.description: The problem statement's UML declares SealSaloon.totalOrders as type int, while the provided solution implementation declares totalOrders as a long. This type mismatch between the specification and reference implementation can confuse students about the expected type and may lead to inconsistency in tests or grading expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the types: either change the UML/specification in problem_statement.md to indicate long for totalOrders, or change the solution (and any tests) to use int for totalOrders. Prefer updating the solution to use int to match the UML, unless large-order counts are expected, in which case update the UML and problem text to explain the use of long.
